notes.title: 2023.1.25 update
notes.notes:
1. A new multi-language version (English/Japanese) has been added, and the length of the text has been adapted to a certain extent, but there are still very few words beyond the UI display.
2, the multi-language version uses the translation software machine, so there is bound to be semantic or strange translation, if there are lovers willing to free polishing (~), the content can be provided to the email: 775141833@qq.com

notes.title: 2022.10.10 update
notes.notes:
Small optimization:
1. A prompt is added to the character details system: [Unlock XX to unlock more character details].
2. The prompt for [Difficulty selection /shift sprint/cheat switch] is easy to ignore because of the quick click of the keyboard, adding 2s display pause.
([shift/Dash/Cheat switch] will only be turned on if you die from starvation to zero.)
ps: If you have any questions, you can add 948843464 to ask.
